## Change summary

Describe the reason, affected identity and files.

## Evidence and authority

Record source references and any nonsensitive decision reference. Do not attach private agreements, signatures or personal data.

## Checks

- [ ] Source artwork and derivatives are labeled accurately.
- [ ] Rights, product naming and public claims are supported.
- [ ] Visual rules, links and metadata agree.
- [ ] Relevant decision authority has reviewed the change.
- [ ] Changelog and integrity records are updated for release.
- [ ] No private data, credentials or font binaries are included.
